app.title: Unkernel: Real Linux kernel, compiled to WebAssembly
app.description: A tool that compiles the full Linux kernel to WebAssembly, enabling running native Linux binaries in browsers or WASI runtimes.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and run the build pipeline to compile the kernel to .wasm.
Deploy the generated .wasm module in a simple web page and verify kernel boot messages.
Execute a basic system call (e.g., read/write) from a WASI program and assert expected output.
Measure build time and memory usage compared to a standard Linux kernel build.
